Name: Void Ghost Pendant without Void Essence
Author: yuhvy
Description:
A quick little mod for everyone who feels that buying the Void Ghost Pendant with what is essentially 200 pieces of Krobus' slain relatives is a little morbid.

Once you reach 10 hearts of friendship with Krobus, the Wizard will send you a letter with a new crafting recipe for the pendant, no Void Essence needed.
